title: Add a relative-time formatter to an existing JS utility module
prompt: In src/format.js, add an exported function formatRelative(thenMs, nowMs) that renders a timestamp relative to now: 'just now' for differences under 60 seconds, then 'N minutes ago' / 'in N minutes', 'N hours ago' / 'in N hours', 'N days ago' / 'in N days', rounding down and using the singular form for 1 ('1 minute ago'). Keep the module's existing style and run the tests with: npm test
